HeadwordSpanReview.GrammarEvidence: All 文殊 tokens occur within Dahui Zonggao’s uninterrupted sermon, framed by 適來禪客問 and 據妙喜見處; embedded dialogue makes Manjusri a quoted case figure but never transfers utterance of the name away from Dahui.

Senses.Explanation: Manjusri is the sword-bearing and assembly-acting figure whom Chan speakers place inside questions about killing, manifestation, and the formal opening of a case. The record uses him as a case participant—showing across mountains, wielding a sword, or striking the sounding block—not as an occasion for an outside life story.
